face.name: 艾维娜
face.text: 你的随从牌的法力值消耗为（1）点。
face.flavorText: 她最喜欢别人说她像翠迪了，我保证。

face.name: Aviana
face.text: Your minions cost (1).
face.flavorText: Call her "Tweety". She'll find it real funny. I PROMISE.

face.name: 艾维娜
face.text: 你的随从牌的法力值消耗为（1）点。

face.name: Aviana
face.text: Your minions cost (1).
face.flavorText: Call her "Tweety". She'll find it real funny. I PROMISE.

face.name: 斯卡基尔
face.text: 你的鱼人法力值消耗为（1）点。
face.flavorText: 想知道这些疤痕是怎么来的吗？他也很想知道。

face.name: Scargil
face.text: Your Murlocs cost (1).
face.flavorText: Wanna know how he got those scars? So does he.

face.name: 安娜科德拉
face.text: 你的自然法术的法力值消耗减少（2）点。
face.flavorText: 有缘千里来组队，须往哀嚎高处寻。

face.name: Lady Anacondra
face.text: Your Nature spells cost (2) less.
face.flavorText: Do you think she got her name before or after she turned into a snake?

face.name: 凯恩·日怒
face.text: 冲锋 所有友方攻击无视 嘲讽。
face.flavorText: “护甲与治疗或许能暂缓我的狂热，但邪能和战刃总能鞭策着我！”

face.name: Kayn Sunfury
face.text: Charge All friendly attacks ignore Taunt.
face.flavorText: "Armor and heals may slow my zeal, but fel and glaives excite me!"

face.name: 重拳先生
face.text: 你的海盗拥有冲锋。
face.flavorText: “重拳先生是我父亲。我是约里克。”

face.name: Mr. Smite
face.text: Your Pirates have Charge.
face.flavorText: “Please, Mr. Smite was my father. Call me Yorik.”

face.name: 老瞎眼
face.text: 冲锋，在战场上每有一个其他鱼人便拥有+1攻击力。
face.flavorText: 他是鱼人中的传奇。“姆咯啦咯咯啦呵嘎哈咯！”他们都这么说他。

face.name: Old Murk-Eye
face.text: Charge. Has +1 Attack for each other Murloc on the battlefield.
face.flavorText: He's a legend among murlocs. "Mrghllghghllghg!", they say.

face.name: 伊纳拉·碎雷
face.text: 在你的回合时，你的英雄拥有+2攻击力和风怒。
face.flavorText: 伊纳拉是观众的最爱，总能收获雷鸣般的掌声。

face.name: Inara Stormcrash
face.text: On your turn, your hero has +2 Attack and Windfury.
face.flavorText: A fan favorite, Inara is always met with thunderous applause.

face.name: 水晶工匠坎格尔
face.text: 圣盾，吸血 你的治疗效果翻倍。
face.flavorText: 他想做坦克，但砰砰博士老叫他做辅助。

face.name: Crystalsmith Kangor
face.text: Divine Shield, Lifesteal Your healing is doubled.
face.flavorText: He wants to tank, but Boom always makes him play support.

face.name: 月牙
face.text: 每次只能受到1点伤害。
face.flavorText: “月额”这个名字听起来就不行。

face.name: Moonfang
face.text: Can only take 1 damage at a time.
face.flavorText: Moonforehead just didn't have the same ring to it.

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

face.name: 恋旧风潮
face.text: 将所有随从变形成为来自过去的随机传说随从。
face.flavorText: 风潮不改旧传说，相看恍如昨。

face.name: Wave of Nostalgia
face.text: Transform ALL minions into random Legendary ones from the past.
face.flavorText: Ja, please don't freeze my minions. No stall, ja????

policies: Aviana and Scargil use the original ordered cost operations;Scargil matches current Murloc/all tribes and imposes no per-turn consumption.
Lady Anacondra adds only friendly_nature_spells with the existing ordinary two-cost reduction;quote/frozen/generated validation share the payer/school condition.
Inara uses existing controller-turn hero Attack and Windfury contributions;actual active-player transitions,source lifecycle and attack budgets remain shared.
Kayn/Smite/Murk-Eye use existing Taunt bypass/current Pirate Charge/current other-battlefield-Murloc count,not guessed names or printed-stat mutation.
Kangor scales all ordinary healing attributed to its controller;Moonfang caps self incoming damage to one through the existing source/target health-rule layers.
Full732 raw identities/order/roles/local weights remain unchanged and no partial executable source is bound.
uncertainties: Uniform local Past reference weights/reprint identity,CN exclusions,version/hotfix and rule-edge calibration remain unchanged pending questions.
Multiple live set-cost aura order and dying/dormant provider policies inherit the existing ordinary ordered interpreter,not new server calibration.
